title: POV: you had a secret knock with your sister
subtitle: TOLD BY THE WALL BETWEEN YOUR ROOMS
hud:
React overlay on 1080x1920. The HUD sits in a band at y=200 to 470 px, below the Instagram top UI. Font: a thin geometric sans with tabular figures (for example Inter Tight 200 for numerals, 500 for labels). The tint follows the color grade: warm white #FFF1DD for 2004-2011, neutral #EDEFF2 for 2013, cool slate #B9C4CE through the drift (2013-2025), and white-gold #FFE7B8 from the payoff at 59.1 s to the end. Tint changes are 20-frame sweeps.

LEFT BLOCK (left-aligned at x=72). The year in 84 px weight-200 numerals. Under it, the ages at 22 px, tracked 0.18em, 70% opacity, always written Nora first: 'NORA 9 │ YOU 6'. Nora is always on the left, and the hairline echoes the wall.

RIGHT BLOCK (right-aligned at x=1008). The clock in 84 px weight-200 ('9:02 PM'). Under it, a date line at 22 px that appears only on milestone nights: 'WED · NOV 3' (b1), 'FRI · AUG 23' (b5), 'WED · DEC 24' (b8-b9). It is blank on every other night.

CENTER BLOCK (centered at x=540). The label 'GOODNIGHT KNOCKS' at 16 px, tracked 0.24em, 60% opacity. Under it, a four-drum mechanical odometer at 64 px with no comma. The drums roll vertically with motion blur, a lit edge and a soft tick on every step, and spin as a blur during time-lapses. Under that, the knock glyph '● ● ●  ┃  ● ● ●': 10 px dots with 14 px gaps. The left three are Nora's blue #7FB4FF and the right three are your amber #FFB45C, split by a 1x22 px hairline. Each real knock lights the next dot on its side with a small bloom. More than three knocks cycle the dots. Dots fade 0.8 s after an exchange ends. A status line (18 px, tracked 0.16em, 65% opacity) appears under the glyph only when needed.

VALUES OVER TIME
b1 0.0-8.0: The HUD fades in at 2.6-3.2. '2004' / 'NORA 9 │ YOU 6' and '9:02 PM' / 'WED · NOV 3'. Odometer '0000'. Blue dots light at 4.0, 4.3 and 4.6; amber dots at 5.9, 6.2 and 6.5. At 6.7 the odometer rolls '0000'→'0001'. Dots fade at 7.4.
b2 8.0-15.0: The year rolls 2004→2007 and the ages 'NORA 9 │ YOU 6'→'NORA 11 │ YOU 9'. The clock flickers between 8:31 and 9:48 PM. The odometer spins 0001→0897, and faint dot pairs blink with each flashed night. At 10.4 it settles on '2007', 'NORA 11 │ YOU 9', '9:15 PM', '0897'. Blue dots at 13.1, 13.25 and 13.4; amber at 13.5, 13.65 and 13.8. The odometer rolls to '0898' at 13.9. From 13.9 to 15.0 it spins to '1520', the year reaches '2008' and the ages 'NORA 13 │ YOU 10'.
b3 15.0-22.5: '2009' / 'NORA 14 │ YOU 11', '2:14 AM'. The odometer holds at '1718' (not a goodnight). The amber dots alone flash eleven times, cycling, from 16.0 to 17.4.
b4 22.5-28.0: '2011' / 'NORA 16 │ YOU 13', '11:52 PM', odometer '2533'. Blue dots at 25.3, 25.6 and 25.9; amber at 26.5, 26.75 and 27.0. '2534' at 27.1.
b5 28.0-36.0: '2013' / 'NORA 18 │ YOU 15', '11:58 PM' / 'FRI · AUG 23', odometer '3215'. Blue dots at 29.2, 29.45 and 29.7, fading at 30.4. Blue again at half brightness at 32.4, 32.7 and 33.0. Amber at 34.0, 34.3 and 34.6. '3216' at 34.8. At 35.3 the drums dim to 40% and a thin underline turns grey (a detent lock). At 35.5 all dots go dark and stay dark.
b6 36.0-42.0: The odometer stays at '3216', dim. At 36.3 the status line fades in as 'LAST KNOCK · 1 NIGHT AGO' and rolls up to 'LAST KNOCK · 1,093 NIGHTS AGO' by 42.0. The year rolls 2013→2016 and the ages 'NORA 18 │ YOU 15'→'NORA 21 │ YOU 18'. The clock flickers. During mom's treadmill (37.0-38.0) grey rings pulse in the wall, but no dot lights and the odometer does not move. The tint slides to slate.
b7 42.0-47.5: The HUD steps with each text. '2017' / 'NORA 21 │ YOU 19' / '12:01 AM' / 'LAST KNOCK · 1,299 NIGHTS AGO'. At 44.0: '2020' / 'NORA 25 │ YOU 22' / '11:58 PM' / '2,482 NIGHTS AGO'. At 45.6: '2024' / 'NORA 28 │ YOU 26' / '4:37 PM' / '3,856 NIGHTS AGO'.
b8 47.5-55.0: '2025' / 'NORA 30 │ YOU 27', '8:12 PM' / 'WED · DEC 24'; at 49.0 the clock jumps to '11:47 PM'. Odometer '3216' dim, status 'LAST KNOCK · 4,506 NIGHTS AGO'. From 52.6 to 53.2, while your knuckles hover, the '4,506' digits shiver: they roll 2 px up and back and flicker between 60% and 100% twice, then settle.
b9 55.0-67.5: '11:49 PM'. Amber dots at 55.0, 55.3 and 55.6, and they stay lit. At 55.9 the status line crossfades to 'WAITING FOR AN ANSWER', with a 220x2 px bar under it filling evenly from 55.9 to 58.4. Blue dots at 58.4, 58.7 and 59.0. At 59.0 the status line and bar fade out (0.4 s). At 59.1 the odometer un-dims from 40% to 100%, the grey underline clears, and the drums roll '3216'→'3217' with a tick, while the tint sweeps from slate to white-gold. From 60.8 to 62.0 the blue dots flash eleven times; the odometer stays at 3217. Dots fade at 62.6. Clock '11:50 PM' at 63.0 and '11:51 PM' at 66.5.
END 67.5-71.5: Only the center block remains, scaled to 70% at the top. Odometer '3217'. At 70.4, 70.7 and 71.0 the three blue dots light with the end knocks. The amber dots stay dark: it is your turn.
caption_style: Lowercase italic serif (for example Newsreader Italic) at 44 px with 1.25 line height, warm white #FFF6EA at 94%, and a soft shadow (0 2 12 px, rgba(0,0,0,0.55)). Centered at x=540 inside x=90 to 930, clear of the right-side icon rail. Baseline at y=1430, above the Instagram bottom UI: one line, two at most. Fades in over 10 frames with a 6 px upward drift and fades out over 10 frames. Only one caption is on screen at a time. No caption sits over a face at a ripple peak. Title card (b1 only, 0.2-3.0 s): 'POV: you had a secret knock with your sister' in 58 px sentence-case sans at weight 600, with 'TOLD BY THE WALL BETWEEN YOUR ROOMS' under it in 20 px caps tracked 0.28em. Both sit at y=1080-1300, over the floor at the foot of the beds and away from the faces.

beats.stamp: 2004 · NORA 9 │ YOU 6 · WED NOV 3 · 9:02 PM · KNOCKS 0000 → 0001
beats.setting: Hero house slice in its 'first night' dressing. The family has just moved in, and this is the first time each child has a room of their own. LEFT, Nora: lavender rug; a white twin bed flush against the shared wall with a purple star quilt; a moon-shaped nightlight plugged into an outlet set just above mattress height beside her pillow, its cover sitting crooked with a 4 mm gap at the top (planted for b2); two taped boxes marked 'NORA'S STUFF — KEEP OUT' in purple marker; a unicorn poster on the back wall over the headboard. RIGHT, you: a blue rug printed with dinosaur footprints; a racecar duvet; a small pine corner shelf screwed to the shared wall just above the top of your pillow, with a green plastic T-rex standing on it; an open box of toys; a dinosaur lamp, switched off. The hallway strip at the top of frame is lit. The front windows at the bottom have no curtains yet, and dry leaves sit on the porch roof below them.
beats.action: 0.0-3.0 (title on): Nora (9) lies on her back with her hands folded on the quilt, calm, blinking at the ceiling. You (6) lie on your back with the duvet pulled up to your nose, eyes wide, glancing at the dark corners and the box shapes. 3.0: the hallway light clicks off and the top strip goes dark. Only the moon nightlight and the streetlight shaft remain. 3.3: you squeeze your eyes shut, open them again, and pull the duvet higher with both fists. 3.8: Nora glances at the wall with a small, decided look and rolls onto her left side to face it. 4.0 / 4.3 / 4.6: three slow knocks with the index and middle knuckles of her left hand at pillow height, the hand recoiling 1 cm after each contact. 4.9: you freeze, and your eyes slide to the wall. 5.3: you roll onto your right side to face the wall, mouth open (gap tooth showing). 5.9 / 6.2 / 6.5: you answer with the bottom of your right fist, hammer-style, far too hard. The shelf jolts, and on the third knock the T-rex topples flat. 6.6-8.0: you look up at the fallen T-rex, then back at the wall, and grin enormously. On her side, Nora presses her lips together against a laugh, shoulders shaking, and pulls the quilt over her mouth. Both of you grin at the wall, unseen by each other, and burrow down. Two profiles face each other across the seam.
captions: your first night in your own room.
beats.camera: PLAN WIDE, locked 0.0-3.5. The camera sits on the vertical plane of the shared wall's center line, three.js fov 30° (long lens), 10.6 m from the pillow plane, tilted 18° from straight down toward the back wall. The frame is 3.2 m across at the pillows: the hallway at the top, both beds full length, the front windows and porch roof at the bottom. 3.5-8.0: a slow eased descent straight down the wall line to MEDIUM (1.4 m across, 4.6 m away), with both pillows, the nightlight and the shelf filling the middle of frame. Faces stay in the center 60%.
beats.ui: Title and subtitle 0.2-3.0 (fade in over 0.3 s, out from 2.6 to 3.0). HUD fades in 2.6-3.2 with '2004' / 'NORA 9 │ YOU 6', '9:02 PM' / 'WED · NOV 3', 'GOODNIGHT KNOCKS' and '0000'. Blue dots at 4.0, 4.3 and 4.6; amber at 5.9, 6.2 and 6.5. '0001' at 6.7. Caption 1 runs 3.2-5.6 and caption 2 runs 5.8-7.9.
beats.lighting: Until 3.0: warm 2700K hallway ceiling light spills through the doorway gaps at the top of frame. After 3.0: a cool 4000K streetlight shaft through the bare front windows lays long window-and-muntin rectangles across both floors and the foot of both beds. Nora's moon nightlight (2200K, about 0.4 m falloff) pools on her pillow and the seam. Your side is darker because the dino lamp is off.
beats.effects: Signature knock ripples. Each knock emits a world-space ring of light from the knuckle contact point. The ring's radius grows from 0 to 1.6 m over 0.9 s; it is 4 cm wide and fades with distance. Blue #7FB4FF from Nora, amber #FFB45C from you. It crosses the wall: the seam glows and 6-10 dust motes lift inside the cavity. It then washes faintly over the other child's face and pillow. Your whole-fist rings are 30% thicker and wobble. Grade: warm gold with soft halation on the practicals, fine 35 mm-style grain, a gentle vignette, and subtle tilt-shift falloff at the top and bottom of frame so the house reads as a precious miniature.
beats.sfx: Room tone of an unfamiliar, half-unpacked house: bigger and more echoey than in later eras. Wind on the glass, dry leaves skittering on the porch roof, a distant dog. 3.0: the hallway light-switch click at top center, then a far bedroom door latch. Duvet rustle. Nora's knocks are crisp two-knuckle taps on drywall over a stud, panned left, with a far-side copy low-passed to about 1.2 kHz, 30 ms late, panned right. Your knocks are heavy, boomy fist thumps panned right, with the far copy on the left. The shelf rattles and the plastic T-rex clacks flat. Odometer tick at 6.7. Covers rustle as you both burrow.
beats.music: 0.0: felt piano enters pianissimo, Dmaj9 to Gmaj7 at 70 BPM. It rests under the knocks. 6.8: the music box plays the motif F#5-E5-D5 once, and the piano answers with a soft open D chord.

beats.stamp: 2004 → 2008 time-lapse · real time on THU APR 19, 2007 · 9:15 PM · NORA 11 │ YOU 9 · KNOCKS 0001 → 0898 → 1520
beats.setting: The same slice, re-dressed night by night. The boxes vanish and curtains appear. A puppy bed appears in Nora's doorway. In winter 2005 about 40 glow-in-the-dark stars and a crescent moon appear on Nora's ceiling. They float as stickers on the cut-away ceiling plane at 2.5 m. Your racecar duvet becomes a soccer-ball duvet and Nora's star quilt becomes a patchwork quilt. For a few weeks of 2006 your right forearm is in a signed white cast. Outside, the porch roof cycles through leaves, snow drifts, rain splashes, blossom petals and green summer.
beats.time_of_day: Nights and mornings flashing past, then one real-time spring night at 9:15 PM
beats.action: 8.0-10.4: time-lapse at about three nights per second. Every night the hallway goes dark and a blue ring, then an amber ring, pulses at the seam like a heartbeat. Every morning sun shafts sweep across the floors. The kids grow inside white-flash dissolves on the night cuts. Moose, the beagle puppy, sleeps curled in Nora's doorway most nights. The glow stars appear. Your cast appears and then disappears. 10.4: hard cut on a night flash to real time, in MEDIUM. Nora (11, one braid, yellow clip, purple tee) and you (9, soccer pajama tee) lie on your backs, arms crossed tight, scowling straight up with your jaws set. Both faces are to camera. 11.4-12.3: Nora uncrosses her arms, slides a folded notebook page out from under her pillow and, without looking, pushes it into the gap at the top of the crooked outlet cover beside her pillow. It disappears into the wall, and she crosses her arms again. 12.3-13.1: CAVITY MACRO insert. The folded note slips through the gap into the dark cavity, flutters down between two pine studs through the nightlight glow leaking around the outlet box, and settles on the dusty bottom plate. It falls half open: 'sorry —N' in purple marker. 13.1-13.45: back in MEDIUM, she knocks three times, hard and grudging, without changing her scowl. 13.5-13.85: you unfold one arm, thump three times without looking, and fold it again. Neither scowl breaks. 13.9-15.0: hard cut on a night flash back to WIDE, and the time-lapse resumes through New Year's Eve 2008.
captions: every night. even when you weren't speaking.
beats.camera: PLAN WIDE, locked, 8.0-10.4 and 13.9-15.0, using the same preset as the start of b1 so every change reads. MEDIUM, locked, 10.4-12.3 and 13.1-13.9 (1.4 m across): both faces up, arms crossed, the outlet and shelf in frame. 12.3-13.1: CAVITY MACRO, the wall's own eye. The lens sits inside the cavity between the two studs nearest Nora's pillow, 1.4 m above the floor, pointing straight down the slot, fov 60°, focus following the note.
beats.ui: The HUD rolls the year, ages, clock and odometer as described in the HUD spec. Blue dots at 13.1, 13.25 and 13.4; amber at 13.5, 13.65 and 13.8. '0898' at 13.9, then a spin to '1520'. The caption runs 10.6-14.8.
beats.lighting: Time-lapse: 5500K sun shafts sweep across floors and beds from east to west. On night frames the hallway light switches off and the moon nightlight glows. Fight night: nightlight and streetlight only. In the macro, a thin warm sliver of light leaks through the outlet gap.
beats.effects: Time-lapse lighting, porch-roof season dressings, aging hidden inside 2-frame white flash-dissolves on the night cuts, light motion blur on bodies in the fast section. The glow-star layer: pale green #CFFFD9 emissive on night frames and invisible on day frames. Macro: drifting dust motes in the slot, and the note's flutter rendered at 60 fps and played at half speed.
beats.sfx: Fast section: a muffled, heartbeat-like pulse of distant knock pairs under the music, with season ambiences flicking past at low level (wind, rain, birds, a far-off lawnmower). Real time: crickets, a clock ticking in the hallway, notebook paper sliding, a dry papery scrape at the outlet gap. Macro: everything turns hollow and close (low-passed house tone), with the note's faint flutter and a tiny tap as it lands in the dust. The grudging knocks are hard, flat and slightly too fast. Odometer tick.
beats.music: 8.0-10.4: a felt-piano eighth-note ostinato on D-A-F#, with celesta sparkles on the night pulses. 10.4: it drops to a single held low D. 13.9: after the grudging exchange the piano plays the motif F#-E-D, a little firm and quick, and the ostinato resumes under the time-lapse to 15.0.

beats.stamp: 2009 · NORA 14 │ YOU 11 · 2:14 AM (night of FRI JUL 17) · KNOCKS 1718 (unchanged)
beats.setting: A summer thunderstorm. Rain sheets past the front windows and overflows the porch-roof gutter. Both rooms are dark apart from Nora's moon nightlight, a plug-in nightlight in the hallway, and the lightning. Moose (now a young beagle) sleeps in the hallway. Your room: striped sheets, soccer posters on the back wall, the T-rex still on the shelf.
beats.action: 15.0: lightning throws window shapes across both floors and beds for 3 frames, with a close thunder crack. 15.2-16.0: you (11, shaggy hair, striped tee) lie on your back, blanket pulled to your chin, eyes wide. A second flash at 15.8. 16.0-17.4: you roll to the wall and knock eleven times fast, about 0.12 s apart, with your right knuckles. Eleven amber rings stack and overlap. 17.4-18.0: Nora (14, ponytail, camp tee) opens her eyes, stares at the ceiling and lets out a puffed-cheek 'seriously?' exhale, then throws back her quilt. 18.0-18.6: she sits up, gathers her pillow and quilt in one armful and stands. 18.6-19.4: she walks out of her door at top left. Her ponytail, shoulders and the bundled quilt pass along the hallway above the cut top of the back wall. 19.4-19.8: your door opens at top right. A lightning flash at 19.5 and the hallway nightlight behind her stretch her long shadow across your floor to your bed. 19.8-20.8: she drops the pillow and quilt on the rug beside your bed, on the outer side, and lies down on her side with her back to you. 20.3: Moose trots in after her and flops across her ankles, face toward camera, eyes closing. 20.8-21.6: you inch to the edge of the mattress and peek down at her. She is already asleep, mouth slightly open. 21.6-22.5: you roll onto your back, your face relaxes and your eyes close.
beats.camera: MEDIUM, locked, 15.0-18.0: 1.6 m across at the pillows, with both profiles on the pillows. 18.0-19.4: a smooth eased rise straight up the wall line to PLAN WIDE, so we follow her down the hallway and into your doorway. 19.4-22.5: PLAN WIDE, locked. Render a clean plate of 21.6-22.5, with all of you settled, as the source for the double exposure in b9.
beats.ui: HUD: '2009' / 'NORA 14 │ YOU 11', '2:14 AM', odometer '1718', unchanged. Only the amber dots flash, eleven times, cycling, 16.0-17.4. Caption 1 runs 16.4-19.0 and caption 2 runs 19.8-22.3.
beats.lighting: A near-dark blue-violet base. Lightning at 15.0, 15.8 and 19.5, with a distant flicker at 21.0: 3-frame 6500K hard directional bursts through the front windows that slam window-and-muntin shapes across both rooms and throw long hard shadows. The warm 2400K hallway nightlight throws Nora's shadow into your room at 19.4-19.8.
beats.effects: Rain-streaked glazing with refracting droplets in the window sections. Gutter overflow sheets and splashes on the porch roof. Eleven overlapping amber rings that build into a bright flicker at the seam. Blue-violet grade.
beats.sfx: Heavy rain on glass and on the porch roof, gutter overflow, rolling thunder, and a close crack at 15.0. Your eleven knocks: light, urgent and fast, panned right, with the far copies on the left. Then the quilt dragging, bare feet on floorboards, Nora's door latch, a hallway floorboard creak, your door latch, the pillow and quilt landing on the rug, dog tags jingling and paws on the rug, and the soft thump of Moose flopping down. The thunder rolls away by 22.5.
beats.music: Felt piano in its low register, playing sparse Bm(add9) and G chords under the rain and staying clear of the knocks. 21.0: as she settles, the celesta plays the motif F#-E-D softly, an octave below b1.

beats.setting: Teen dressing. Nora's side: warm fairy lights wound around her headboard, a heap of clothes on the floor, photo-booth strips taped to the headboard. Your side: a navy duvet, a generic game controller and a laptop on the floor, a soccer ball, the T-rex on the shelf next to a small tin of orange foam earplugs.
beats.action: 22.5-24.0: Nora (16, straightened hair fanned across the pillow, lavender hoodie) lies on her back holding her phone over her face, thumbs flying, laughing silently, heels drumming the mattress so the bed thuds against the wall. Each new message lights her face. You (13, braces, grey hoodie) lie with your pillow mashed over your head. 24.0-25.0: you reach up to the shelf, take two orange earplugs from the tin, roll them between your fingers, jam them in and glare at the wall. 25.0-25.3: she lays the phone on her chest, smiles dreamily up at the ceiling (face to camera) and rolls toward the wall. 25.3 / 25.6 / 25.9: three two-knuckle knocks. 26.0: the blue rings pass through your pillow and your head bobs slightly. You can't hear the knocks, but you feel them, and your eyes open. 26.2-26.5: you pull out your right earplug and roll your eyes hugely. 26.5 / 26.75 / 27.0: you knock three times back, the earplug still pinched between your thumb and finger. 27.1-28.0: you jam the earplug back in. Nora grins at the wall and picks her phone back up.
captions: she got a boyfriend. you got earplugs.
beats.camera: MEDIUM-TIGHT (1.2 m across), with a very slow 0.3 m slide along the wall line over the beat, from mid-bed toward the pillows. The camera never leaves the wall's center plane.
beats.ui: HUD: '2011' / 'NORA 16 │ YOU 13', '11:52 PM', odometer '2533'. Blue dots at 25.3, 25.6 and 25.9; amber at 26.5, 26.75 and 27.0; '2534' at 27.1. The caption runs 22.8-27.6.
beats.lighting: Nora's fairy lights (2400K points with soft bloom) and her phone screen as a cool 6500K key 30 cm from her face. A dim streetlight shaft. Your side is lit only by spill and the blue rings.
beats.effects: Bloom on the fairy lights. The teen grade is cooler and a little more saturated. The rings visibly pass through your pillow and lift a strand of your hair.
beats.sfx: A tinny instrumental pop loop from her phone speaker (no vocals), soft message chimes, her heels drumming the mattress and the bed thudding the wall. Earplug foam squeaking as you roll it. From 24.8 to 26.2 the whole mix drops to a heavy low-pass, as if we are wearing the earplugs too, and her knocks arrive only as felt sub-thumps. At 26.2, when one earplug comes out, the mix opens again, right channel first. Your knocks are crisp, panned right. Odometer tick.
beats.music: A soft brushed snare and shaker pulse joins the felt piano at 70 BPM. It is low-passed along with everything else while the earplugs are in. 27.2: the motif F#-E-D plays on piano and music box.

beats.stamp: 2013 · NORA 18 │ YOU 15 · FRI AUG 23 · 11:58 PM · KNOCKS 3215 → 3216 (FREEZES)
beats.setting: Nora's room is stripped. The carpet is darker where her rug used to lie. Taped boxes read 'DORM — BOOKS' and 'DORM — FRAGILE', next to a mini-fridge and a desk lamp packed in a box. Her mattress is bare and she is in a sleeping bag. The moon nightlight is packed, so the outlet is bare, but the glow stars still glow faintly. Your room is unchanged, T-rex on the shelf.
beats.action: 28.0-29.2: Nora (18, messy bun, yellow clip, grey college tee) lies on her left side in the sleeping bag, facing the wall, awake. You (15, lanky, black tee) lie on your left side facing away from the wall, toward your window, eyes open and jaw tight. Your profile faces screen right. 29.2 / 29.45 / 29.7: she knocks three times. 29.9-32.4: nothing, for 2.5 s. Your eyes flick toward the wall behind you and back, and your jaw works. 32.4 / 32.7 / 33.0: she knocks again, softer and slower, and the rings are smaller. 33.0-34.0: she waits, then pulls the sleeping bag up to her chin, eyes still on the wall. 34.0: you roll over to face the wall and rest your forehead against it. 34.0 / 34.3 / 34.6: three soft knocks with your right knuckles. On her side, her palm comes up and lies flat against the wall. 34.8-36.0: she closes her eyes and gives a small, lips-pressed smile, with no tears. Hold on the two profiles nose to nose across 12 cm of wall: her palm on one side, your forehead on the other.
beats.camera: A very slow 8 s descent down the wall line from MEDIUM (1.6 m across) to TWO-SHOT (0.8 m across, 2.64 m away). The two faces end at 16% of frame height each, with the seam dead center. Save the final frame as the TWO-SHOT ECHO preset for b8 and b9. One out-of-focus glow star floats as a soft green disc at the top left.
beats.ui: HUD: '2013' / 'NORA 18 │ YOU 15', '11:58 PM' / 'FRI · AUG 23', odometer '3215'. Dot timing as in the HUD spec. '3216' at 34.8, the 40% dim and lock at 35.3, all dots dark at 35.5. Caption 1 runs 28.4-31.8 and caption 2 runs 32.6-35.8.
beats.lighting: Moonlight only: a cool 4100K silver shaft through the front windows, falling across both beds. The faint glow stars. No nightlight.
beats.effects: The second set of rings is at 60% radius and 50% intensity. Depth of field narrows as the camera descends, so the boxes blur and the faces stay sharp. Warmth drains from the grade toward neutral.
beats.sfx: Late-August crickets, a distant car passing, the sleeping bag's nylon rustle. Her first knocks are clear on the left. Then 2.5 s of crickets only. Her second knocks are softer. Your forehead meets the wall with a soft, dull touch, and your three soft knocks come from the right. Odometer tick at 34.8 and a small mechanical detent click at 35.3 as it locks.
beats.music: Piano alone, sparse, rubato near 64 BPM. A barely audible low-D pedal under the 2.5 s non-answer and the softer knocks. 34.8: the full motif F#-E-D one last time, slower, with the D held until it decays to nothing by 36.0.

beats.setting: The house without Nora, then without you. Her bed is replaced by a treadmill with its side rail flush against the shared wall. In Aug 2016 your room becomes the guest room: beige duvet, six decorative pillows, and a candle set beside the T-rex on the shelf, because mom kept it.
beats.time_of_day: Days and nights sweeping past, with one real-time afternoon in 2014
beats.action: 36.0-37.0: Sat Aug 24, 2013, morning. In one flash Nora's boxes, sleeping bag and mattress are gone, the bed frame goes after them, and sun shafts sweep the empty floor. On your side the nights flicker past as a 60% ghost layer: you (15 to 16) asleep every night with your back to the wall. 37.0-38.8: real time, 2014, cut to MEDIUM. Mom (Ellen) power-walks on the treadmill, beaming, arms pumping, readers bouncing on her head. Every footfall thuds the wall and sends a small grey ring through the cavity. 38.0: she slaps the stop key, steps off the back, staggers two steps and flops flat on her back on the carpet, arms and legs out like a starfish, readers askew, cheeks red, laughing silently up at the ceiling. Her face is to camera. 38.8-40.4: back to WIDE, time-lapse. Laundry piles up on the treadmill night by night: a towel, then sweaters, then hangers along the handlebars, until it is a full drying rack. Your side: you (17, 18) flicker past; in Aug 2016 boxes marked 'DORM — BOOKS' appear, then you and the boxes are gone. 40.4-42.0: in time-lapse, mom dresses your room as the guest room, sets a candle on the shelf next to the T-rex and leaves the T-rex there. Both rooms sit empty. A cobweb forms across the cavity at the cut top of the wall.
captions: mom turned her room into a gym. briefly.
beats.camera: PLAN WIDE, locked, 36.0-37.0 and 38.8-42.0. 37.0-38.8: cut to MEDIUM (1.6 m across), slid along the wall line toward the front so the treadmill's foot end and mom's flopped face are central, with her face about 8% of frame height. All cuts land on time-lapse flashes.
beats.ui: HUD: the dim '3216', with 'LAST KNOCK · 1 NIGHT AGO' fading in at 36.3 and rolling to '1,093 NIGHTS AGO' by 42.0. The year rolls 2013→2016, the ages 'NORA 18 │ YOU 15'→'NORA 21 │ YOU 18', the clock flickers. During the treadmill thuds both dot sets stay dark and the odometer does not move. The tint slides to slate. The caption runs 37.2-40.6.
beats.lighting: Time-lapse 5500K sun shafts sweep across empty floors through dense dust motes. Mom's sliver is flat afternoon daylight. Night frames are almost black, with only the faint stars.
beats.effects: Grey rings (#9AA3AB, 40% radius) for the treadmill thuds. They fade inside the cavity and never reach the other side. The furniture swaps are hidden in flash-dissolves. Volumetric dust shafts. The cobweb catches the sun. The grade drains from neutral to desaturated slate, and the glow stars dim to 30%.
beats.sfx: Time-lapse room tone, with seasons flicking past at low level. The treadmill motor whirs and the belt slaps, sneakers thud, and the wall gives dull, unresonant thuds with no stud ring. The stop beep is soft and generic. Mom lands on the carpet with a whump and the treadmill winds down. No vocal sounds. Then hanger clacks and laundry rustle as the pile grows, packing tape screeching on boxes, and a door closing.
beats.music: The drift theme: distant felt piano with heavy felt and a warm analog pad, very quiet. The motif plays only F#-E, at 37.4 and again at 40.6, and never reaches the D. No brushes.

beats.setting: The same two empty rooms in time-lapse at dusk blue. The porch roof cycles through snow and rain. The treadmill-rack sits against the wall on the left, and the guest bed with its six pillows sits on the right.
beats.action: A generic chat card slides up over the empty rooms (no real-brand styling). The header shows a round avatar, a photo of Nora at 9 in braids and the yellow clip, and the name 'Nora (bossy)'. One exchange is shown at a time, each scrolling away for the next. Screen 1, 42.3-44.0: separator 'TUE, MAR 14, 2017 · 12:01 AM'. Nora, left: 'HAPPY BIRTHDAY LITTLE BRO!!! 🎉🎉 come visit!!' (42.5). You, right: 'thank u!! i will' (43.2). Screen 2, 44.0-45.6: separator 'TUE, JUN 9, 2020 · 11:58 PM'. You: 'happy bday nora' (44.3). Nora: 'ty!' (45.0). Screen 3, 45.6-47.3: separator 'THU, MAR 14, 2024 · 4:37 PM'. Nora: 'hbd' (45.9). At 46.6 your small ❤️ tapback lands on the corner of her bubble. 47.0-47.5: the card slides down and fades out. Behind it, the empty rooms keep cycling through day and night.
captions: there was no fight. it just got shorter.
beats.camera: PLAN WIDE with a very slow 3% descent down the wall line. The rooms behind the card are softly defocused.
beats.ui: Chat card: 860x620 px, centered at y=980, dark frosted glass rgba(20,24,30,0.72) with a 28 px radius and 24 px background blur. Avatar is 56 px with a 30 px name. Date separators are 18 px tracked caps. Nora's bubbles are on the left, tinted blue #2E4766. Yours are on the right, tinted amber #6B4A24. Text is white at 34 px. No read receipts and no typing dots. HUD values step with each screen as in the HUD spec. The caption runs 44.2-47.2, below the card.

beats.effects: Background blur behind the card, the seasons cycling, the glow stars almost gone (the last few flicker out across these years).
beats.sfx: Very low wind, snow hush and rain, crossfading as the seasons pass. One soft, tuned UI ping as each bubble arrives. Each exchange pings F# then E. In 2024 'hbd' pings F#, and the tapback gets only a muted, unpitched tick. The motif is never completed.
beats.music: The same distant pad and piano. The pings carry the unfinished motif. No D anywhere.

beats.stamp: 2025 · NORA 30 │ YOU 27 · WED DEC 24 · 8:12 PM → 11:47 PM · LAST KNOCK 4,506 NIGHTS AGO
beats.setting: Christmas Eve. Snow falls past the front windows, and multicolor lights glow along the porch-roof gutter below them. Warm string lights and pine garland line the hallway at the top of frame. At 8:12 PM, in Nora's room, an inflated air mattress made up with sheets and a folded quilt stands in the middle of the room where mom set it up, with the laundry-covered treadmill against the wall. On your side, the guest bed is against the wall with all six decorative pillows on it. On the shelf: a candle, a pine sprig and the T-rex. Four last glow stars cling to Nora's ceiling plane.
beats.action: 47.5-49.0: both rooms are empty. 47.7-48.7: headlights from the street sweep through the front windows. Muntin shadows slide across both floors, over the mid-room air mattress and the made-up guest bed. 48.6 and 48.8: two muffled car doors. 49.0: hard night flash to 11:47 PM, in the same locked frame. Now the treadmill-rack has been shoved diagonally into the middle of Nora's room. Its four rubber feet have left dents in the carpet against the wall, the rug is rucked from the drag, and the air mattress is pushed tight against the wall where her bed used to be. The decorative pillows are stacked on the floor beside your bed. Nora (30, messy bun, yellow clip, glasses, cream sweater) lies on her left side facing the wall, scrolling, her face lit cool by the phone. You (27, short beard, cowlick, grey crewneck) lie on your right side facing the wall, scrolling. 50.6: you lock your phone and lay it face-down on the duvet, and your side drops into snow-light. 51.4: your eyes lift to the wall. 52.0-53.4: you raise your right knuckles to the wall and stop 2 cm short. You hold there for a second while the HUD digits shiver, then lower your hand. 53.6-55.0: on her side, Nora stops scrolling, lowers the phone to the edge of the mattress and looks up at the ceiling. The four faint green stars are reflected in her glasses. Her look is wistful and unguarded.
captions: you both still slept on the wall side.
beats.camera: PLAN WIDE, locked, 47.5-49.8, spanning the 49.0 flash so the before and after read in the same frame. 49.8-53.0: a slow descent down the wall line to the TWO-SHOT ECHO preset, matching the last frame of b5 exactly, then held 53.0-55.0. Focus breathes onto your hovering knuckles at 52.2, then back to your eyes at 53.2.
beats.ui: HUD: '2025' / 'NORA 30 │ YOU 27', '8:12 PM' / 'WED · DEC 24', becoming '11:47 PM' at 49.0. Dim '3216', 'LAST KNOCK · 4,506 NIGHTS AGO'. The digits shiver from 52.6 to 53.2. The caption runs 49.8-52.6.
beats.lighting: 8:12 PM: a moving 4300K headlight spot with a window-muntin gobo sweeps the floors. The string lights spill warm 2200K light through both doorways, and the gutter lights shine outside. 11:47 PM: the phone screens are the cool keys on both faces. Once your phone goes face-down, your side is lit only by blue snow-light and the warm doorway spill. Cold moonlight against warm string light.
beats.effects: Snow particles outside, with bokeh from the gutter lights. The before and after of the room changes across the flash. Four tiny green star reflections in Nora's lenses (screen-space reflection or a baked lens decal). The digit shiver on the HUD.
beats.sfx: Tires crunching on snow, two muffled car doors, the front door far below. Then the house at night: furnace hum, snow hush, a hallway clock ticking once a second. Your phone lands face-down on the duvet with a soft tap. The air mattress's vinyl creaks under Nora. While your knuckles hover there is only the clock.
beats.music: The pad thins to one held E, the note that never resolved, and fades out by 52.0. From 52.0 on: true silence, room tone only.

beats.action: 55.0 / 55.3 / 55.6: you knock three times with your right knuckles, gently and deliberately. Amber rings cross the dark wall into her room and dust lifts in the cavity. On the third knock the T-rex on the shelf tips over, just as it did when you were six. You glance up at it, and the corner of your mouth lifts. 55.2: Nora's eyes go wide on the first knock. 55.9-58.4: total stillness for 2.5 s. Her phone sinks to the mattress screen-up, lighting her chin from below. She doesn't move. At 57.0 her chin trembles and she presses her lips together. At 57.6 you exhale, and at 58.0 you begin to roll away from the wall. 58.4 / 58.7 / 59.0: three knocks from her side, two knuckles of her left hand. Her blue rings meet your fading amber inside the cavity, and the whole seam blooms warm white (59.0-59.6). 59.3-60.1: CAVITY MACRO insert, frame-matched to b2. White-gold light floods down between the studs, golden motes rise, and the folded 'sorry —N' note is lit on the bottom plate under 18 years of dust and a cobweb. 60.1-60.6: back in the two-shot, you freeze mid-roll, roll back, and grin into your pillow. 60.6-62.0: Nora laughs silently, wipes one eye with the heel of her right hand, and knocks eleven times fast (60.8-62.0). You laugh silently and shake your head. 62.0-62.6: you pull your pillow out from under your head and swing your legs out, and two decorative pillows tumble off the stack. 62.8: you walk out of your door at top right. 63.2-64.0: your head, shoulders and pillow pass along the hallway beneath the string lights. 64.2: you appear in Nora's doorway at top left, and the string lights behind you throw your long shadow across her floor to the mattress. 64.6: she scoots toward the wall and pats the rug beside the air mattress. 65.0: you drop your pillow on the rug. 65.4: you lie down on your back, your shoulder 10 cm from the edge of the mattress, without touching. 65.4-66.9: DOUBLE EXPOSURE. The clean plate from b3 ghosts in at 35%: 14-year-old Nora on the rug beside 11-year-old you, with Moose across her ankles, on the right side of the wall. It mirrors the two of you now on the left side, and it dissolves out. 66.0-67.5: you both lie on your backs looking up at the four glow stars, which means looking straight up into the lens. 66.8: the hallway string lights click off. Mom was waiting up. Your old room on the right is empty, with the dent of your body in the guest bed and the toppled T-rex on the shelf.
beats.camera: TWO-SHOT ECHO, locked, 55.0-62.6, with the cut to the CAVITY MACRO at 59.3-60.1. 62.6-66.0: one slow, continuous eased rise up the wall line from the two-shot to PLAN WIDE, so the walk reads from above. 66.0-67.5: PLAN WIDE, locked. This frame matches the b3 clean plate exactly for the double exposure.
beats.ui: HUD as in the spec: amber dots, then 'WAITING FOR AN ANSWER' with its bar filling 55.9-58.4, then blue dots, then the odometer un-dimming and rolling '3216'→'3217' at 59.1 as the tint sweeps to white-gold. Eleven blue flashes 60.8-62.0. Clock '11:50 PM' at 63.0 and '11:51 PM' at 66.5. Caption 1 runs 55.3-58.3 and caption 2 runs 63.0-67.2.
beats.lighting: Snow-light and the warm doorway spill. When the rings collide, a warm 3500K glow blooms from inside the seam and lights both faces from the wall. During the rise the grade warms back to the childhood gold. At 66.8 the string lights go off, leaving moonlight, snow-light and the four stars.
beats.effects: An amber and blue ring collision with interference fringes that bloom to warm white, and rising golden dust motes. Macro glow on the note. The double-exposure ghost is composited from the rendered b3 plate at 35% opacity, with a soft luminance key. Snow keeps falling outside. Bloom swells gently on the 3217 roll.
beats.sfx: Room tone, snow hush, furnace, the hallway clock. Your knocks are crisp on the right, with low-passed copies on the left. The T-rex tips with a small plastic tck. During the wait: about two clock ticks and nothing else. Her knocks are crisp on the left. Then her eleven fast taps, the pillows tumbling with soft thumps, feet on floorboards, a door latch, a hallway creak, the air mattress's vinyl squeak as she scoots, your pillow landing on the rug, and a soft switch click at the far end of the hallway at 66.8. Odometer tick at 59.1. No voices, no laughs and no breaths on the track.
beats.music: Silence from 55.0 to 59.0. Your three knocks are tuned F#, E, E, leaving the phrase hanging. Her three are tuned F#, E, D. On her third knock at 59.0, the felt piano enters on a full open D major chord (D2-A2-F#3-A3-D4) and the music box plays the complete motif F#-E-D. 60.5-66.5: low strings (2 celli, viola, double bass) swell gently from pp to mf, cresting at 64.2 as you appear in her doorway, with the b2 piano ostinato returning underneath. 66.5-67.5: they settle onto a sustained Dmaj9.

beats.setting: The final PLAN WIDE, dimmed to 45% and softly blurred. The two of you lie side by side in Nora's room, your old room is empty, and the four stars stay at full brightness.
beats.action: A still frame. Snow keeps falling past the windows. Nothing moves except the snow and a slow breath of bloom on the four stars.
beats.ui: 67.6: the title fades up at y=560: 'POV: you had a secret knock with your sister'. 68.1: a thin 1 px vertical hairline (the wall) at x=540 draws downward from y=760 to y=1180. 68.3: to its left, right-aligned at 30 px caps: 'AS KIDS, SIBLINGS SPEND ABOUT HALF THEIR FREE TIME TOGETHER.' with '(DEMOGRAPHIC RESEARCH, 2017)' under it at 16 px. 68.8: to its right, left-aligned: 'AS ADULTS, ONLY ABOUT HALF FEEL VERY CLOSE TO ONE.' with '(PEW RESEARCH CENTER, 2025 SURVEY)' under it. 69.4: 'WHAT WAS YOUR SECRET SIGNAL?' at y=1380. The HUD center block at the top shows '3217'. At 70.4, 70.7 and 71.0 the blue dots light with the knocks, and the amber dots stay dark.
beats.lighting: Dimmed final wide. The stars are the only full-brightness light.
beats.effects: Text fades in over 0.4 s each, staggered. Light grain. The hairline is drawn on.
beats.sfx: Snow hush and room tone. 70.4 / 70.7 / 71.0: three soft two-knuckle knocks panned left (Nora's sound), then 0.5 s of room tone. No answer comes. The viewer is the one who answers.
beats.music: 67.8-69.4: the piano plays the motif F#-E-D once more, slowly. 69.8: a final soft Dmaj9 that decays out by 70.3, leaving the knocks alone.

characters.name: You (never named on screen; production name Theo)
characters.role: The viewer's stand-in and Nora's little brother. Always the right-hand room, amber rings, panned right.
characters.age: Born Mar 14, 1998. Variants: 6 (b1-b2), 7 (cast, b2 ghost), 9 (b2 fight night), 10 (end of b2), 11 (b3), 13 (b4), 15 (b5), 16-18 (b6 ghost layer only), 27 (b8-b9).
characters.look: Warm light-brown skin, dark brown eyes, thick dark eyebrows, and a small mole under the right eye on every head sculpt. The tell from overhead is a double cowlick at the crown that sticks up at every age, so sculpt it into every haircut. Gap tooth at 6, braces at 13, long lanky limbs at 15, a short neat beard at 27. Always knocks with the right hand: the bottom of the fist at 6, the knuckles from 9 on.
characters.outfit: 6: green dinosaur-print pajamas. 7: the same, plus a signed white forearm cast. 9: oversized soccer pajama tee. 11: red-and-white striped tee. 13: grey hoodie, with orange foam earplugs. 15: black tee with an abstract wave graphic (no real band). 27: heather-grey crewneck.
characters.hair: 6: buzz cut, with the cowlick still showing. 9-11: shaggy. 13: side-swept. 15: longer and messy. 27: short taper, with the cowlick and a short beard.
characters.expression_notes: Needs: wide-eyed fear and an enormous gap-tooth grin (b1); a set-jaw scowl with crossed arms (b2); wide eyes over a blanket, then relieved closed eyes (b3); a glare and a huge teen eye-roll (b4); a tight jaw with open eyes that softens with his forehead on the wall (b5); the 2 cm hover with eyes on the wall (b8); a corner-of-mouth smile at the toppled T-rex, a freeze mid-roll, a grin into the pillow and a silent laugh with a head shake (b9); and a still, open face looking up at the stars, into the lens (final). He never cries.

characters.name: Nora
characters.role: Your big sister and the inventor of the knock. Always the left-hand room, blue rings, panned left. Saved in your phone as 'Nora (bossy)'.
characters.age: Born Jun 9, 1995. Variants: 9 (b1-b2), 11 (b2 fight night), 13 (end of b2), 14 (b3), 16 (b4), 18 (b5), 30 (b8-b9).
characters.look: Fair skin with a band of freckles across the nose (sculpted, not only textured), hazel eyes, a small chin dimple. The tell from overhead is the same yellow plastic hair clip pinned at her crown at every age. Always knocks with two knuckles (index and middle) of her left hand. Round tortoiseshell glasses at 30.
characters.outfit: 9: purple pajamas with yellow stars. 11: purple tee. 14: oversized green camp tee with a generic 'CAMP' graphic. 16: lavender hoodie. 18: grey college tee (generic, no real school). 30: oversized cream cable-knit sweater.
characters.hair: 9: two braids and the clip. 11: one braid and the clip. 14: high ponytail and the clip. 16: long straightened hair fanned across the pillow, with the clip. 18: messy bun and the clip. 30: messy bun and the same clip.
characters.expression_notes: Calm blinking, a decided glance, and a laugh held behind her lips and the quilt (b1); a scowl that never breaks (b2); a puffed-cheek 'seriously?' exhale, then instant sleep (b3); a giddy silent laugh and a dreamy smile at the ceiling (b4); waiting, then a small closed-eye smile with no tears (b5); a wistful upward look with four green stars reflected in her glasses (b8); wide eyes, a trembling chin and pressed lips, then a silent laugh with one eye-wipe (b9). That wipe is the only tear in the film.

characters.name: Ellen (Mom)
characters.role: Seen once, in b6. Otherwise she is implied by the hallway light clicking off in b1, the moved-in guest room, and the string lights clicking off in b9 (she was waiting up).
characters.look: Warm fair skin, laugh lines, rosy cheeks, reading glasses pushed up on her head.
characters.outfit: Navy leggings, brand-new white sneakers with no logos, a coral cardigan tied around her waist, a sports headband.
characters.hair: A chin-length auburn bob going grey at the temples, held back by the headband.
characters.expression_notes: A beaming power-walk with arms pumping. Then a wiped-out, red-cheeked starfish flop onto her back with her readers askew, laughing silently straight up at the camera. This is the one clear look at her face.

sets.name: The house slice (hero set)
sets.description: A roofless dollhouse seen from above. Two upstairs bedrooms, each 2.7 m wide by 3.6 m deep. Nora's is on the left of frame and yours on the right, split by the shared wall running straight down the center of the 9:16 frame. All walls are cut at 2.1 m. The ceiling and roof are removed; only Nora's glow-star stickers remain, floating on the ceiling plane at 2.5 m. Twin beds (0.95 x 1.95 m) sit with their long sides flush against the shared wall and their headboards on the back wall, at the top of frame. That puts the two pillows on either side of the seam, with two profiles able to face each other nose to nose across 12 cm of wall. Doors are in the back wall at the outer corners and open onto the hallway strip. Two windows per room are in the front wall, at the bottom of frame, above a porch roof. Seven dressings of one build: (1) 2004 first night, with boxes; (2) 2004-08 growing up; (3) 2009 storm; (4) 2011 teen; (5) 2013 move-out; (6) 2013-24 drift, with the treadmill turning into a laundry rack and the guest room; (7) 2025 Christmas Eve, with the air mattress moved to the wall.

pine corner shelf on your side of the shared wall, with the green plastic T-rex
purple star quilt, later a patchwork quilt; racecar duvet, then soccer, then navy, then beige guest duvet
moving boxes: 'NORA'S STUFF — KEEP OUT', 'DORM — BOOKS', 'DORM — FRAGILE'
about 40 glow-in-the-dark stars and a crescent moon (Nora's ceiling plane), dwindling to 4
signed white forearm cast
fairy lights around Nora's headboard; photo-booth strips
tin of orange foam earplugs; generic game controller; laptop; soccer ball
Nora's phone (generic); your phone (generic)
sleeping bag; mini-fridge; boxed desk lamp; darker carpet rectangle where her rug lay
treadmill with handlebars, slowly buried under towels, sweaters and hangers; its carpet-foot dents
six decorative pillows; a candle and a pine sprig on the shelf
air mattress made up with sheets and a folded quilt; a rucked rug
rigid, slightly squashed pillow mesh for carrying

sets.name: The shared wall (section and cavity)
sets.description: The narrator. The wall is 12 cm thick: two 5/8-inch drywall skins over 2x4 pine studs at 40 cm centers. Its cut top runs the full depth of the frame as a crisp strip of white plaster skin, dark cavity and pine stud cross-sections. Every cut face is capped, with no backfaces in any lighting state. The cavity carries the ring-light shader and its own dust motes. A high-detail 0.5 m section around the two studs nearest Nora's pillow is built for the two macro inserts: the back of the outlet box with its wires, the 4 mm gap at the top of the crooked cover where light leaks in, a bottom plate whose dust texture blends heavier from 2004 to 2025, the folded 'sorry —N' note (purple marker on lined notebook paper), and a cobweb from 2016 on.
key_props: outlet box, wires and crooked cover gap
folded 'sorry —N' note
bottom plate with accumulating dust
cobweb (2016 onward)
floating dust motes (40 resting, 6-10 kicked up per knock)

sets.name: Hallway strip
sets.description: A 1.1 m wide upstairs hallway behind the back wall, seen across the top of the WIDE frame and through the doorways. Its far ends are closed off with wall and a banister, so an open door never shows a void. Lighting by era: a warm ceiling fixture (2004-2013) whose click-off is the bedtime cue; a warm plug-in nightlight (2009 storm); pine garland and warm string lights along the banister rail (2025), which click off at the end. Built so a walking figure's head, shoulders and pillow read clearly above the back wall's cut top.
key_props: ceiling light fixture
plug-in hallway nightlight
pine garland with warm string lights
Moose's puppy bed (2005-06)
runner rug, floorboards

sets.name: Porch roof and street
sets.description: Outside the front windows at the bottom of frame: an asphalt-shingle porch roof with a gutter, and an implied street beyond. Rigs: a streetlight shaft, lightning flashes, and a moving 4300K headlight spot with a window-muntin gobo. No car model is needed.

lines: POV: you had a secret knock with your sister
AS KIDS, SIBLINGS SPEND ABOUT HALF THEIR FREE TIME TOGETHER. (DEMOGRAPHIC RESEARCH, 2017)
AS ADULTS, ONLY ABOUT HALF FEEL VERY CLOSE TO ONE. (PEW RESEARCH CENTER, 2025 SURVEY)
end_card.stat: AS KIDS, SIBLINGS SPEND ABOUT HALF THEIR FREE TIME TOGETHER. AS ADULTS, ONLY ABOUT HALF FEEL VERY CLOSE TO ONE. (DEMOGRAPHIC RESEARCH, 2017; PEW RESEARCH CENTER, 2025 SURVEY)
end_card.source: Dunifon, Fomby & Musick, "Siblings and children's time use in the United States," Demographic Research 37(49), 2017 (abstract: children with siblings spend about half of their discretionary time engaged with siblings); Pew Research Center, "About half of Americans with siblings are close to at least one of them," Apr 7, 2026 (survey of 6,871 U.S. adults, June 16-29, 2025: 24% extremely + 30% very close = 54%). Shown as two separate halves on either side of the wall hairline, each with its own credit, so it reads as two different studies and not as the same people followed over time. Never add 'still' or 'drops'.

post_caption: Send this to your brother or sister. No message. They'll know. 🤍 What was your secret signal growing up? 👇
music:
Original commissioned score, no vocals and no recognizable melodies. Lead: a felt piano (soft-hammer upright, close-miked, pedal noise kept). Around it: music box and celesta for childhood, brushed snare and shaker for the teen beat, a warm analog pad for the drift, and a small low-string section (2 celli, viola, double bass) for the payoff. Key: D major, 70 BPM, with rubato down to about 64 BPM in b5.

LEITMOTIF: three descending notes, F#-E-D, the 'good-night'. Every answered goodnight is followed by it. Each knock's woody stud resonance is pitch-shifted by about ±40 cents onto those notes (Nora's in the upper octave, yours an octave below), so every exchange quietly plays the motif.

STRUCTURE
0.0-8.0: the piano enters pianissimo on Dmaj9 to Gmaj7. At 6.8 the music box plays the first full F#-E-D.
8.0-15.0: a piano eighth-note ostinato on D-A-F# with celesta sparkles on the night pulses. Fight night drops to a held low D; the motif plays firm at 13.9, and the ostinato resumes.
15.0-22.5: low piano Bm(add9) and G chords under the rain, staying clear of the knocks. The celesta plays the motif an octave down at 21.0.
22.5-28.0: soft brushes and shaker join. Everything is heavily low-passed while the earplugs are in (24.8-26.2), then opens again. The motif plays at 27.2.
28.0-36.0: piano alone, rubato, with a barely-there low-D pedal under the non-answer. The full motif plays one last time at 34.8, and the D is left to decay.
36.0-47.5 (drift): distant felt piano and pad. The motif plays only F#-E (at 37.4 and 40.6), and the tuned chat pings repeat the F#-E pattern. The D is withheld for eleven seconds of screen time.
47.5-52.0: the pad thins to one held E and fades out.
52.0-59.0: true silence. Your knocks sound F#, E, E and leave the phrase hanging.

why_it_works: The witness is a wall: the one thing that kept you apart, and the only thing that ever saw both of you. It watches from above, like a roofless dollhouse. The two beds run the length of the 9:16 frame, so the film's poster image falls into place on its own: two profiles nose to nose, 12 cm apart, a glowing seam between them. The knocks are the only dialogue, and they carry a strict code: blue, left and first for Nora; amber, right and answering for you. The story reads with no words. The behaviors are small and true: a 6-year-old's whole-fist answer that topples his toy T-rex, goodnights knocked through a fight with arms crossed, an apology note that never arrives, eleven knocks that mean 'come here', earplugs out for exactly long enough to answer, and a last-night answer that almost doesn't come. The drift has no villain. You moved out too, mom's gym became a laundry rack, and the birthday texts shrank from 12:01 AM all caps to an afternoon 'hbd' and a heart. Nothing went wrong; it just got shorter, and that is why viewers see themselves in it. The tension works on three levels at once. The odometer has been frozen since 2013. The HUD refuses to count mom's treadmill thuds. A 'LAST KNOCK' line climbs to 4,506 nights. The withheld third note of the motif goes unresolved for eleven seconds of screen time, and a 2.5 s true silence plays under 'WAITING FOR AN ANSWER'. The release then stacks four payoffs in a row. You knock first. She answers on the resolving note, and 3216 becomes 3217. She sends the old eleven-knock 'come here'. This time you are the one carrying the pillow down the hall. Small rewards reach the attentive: the moved air mattress shows she was waiting too, the T-rex topples again, the 2007 'sorry' note lights up inside the wall, and a ghost of the 2009 storm mirrors the two of you across the seam. The final image has both of you looking up into the lens. Light comic beats keep it warm: the toppling T-rex, the matching scowls, the earplugs, mom's starfish flop, 'Nora (bossy)'. The fix needs no phone, just three knocks, so it feels doable tonight. The end card's unanswered knocks and 'No message. They'll know.' turn sending the video into the knock. It stays clearly distinct from the reference: no phone-call payoff, no parent POV, no typed-and-deleted text.

FIXES TO THE WINNER
1. Vantage and geometry. This fixes the 540 px faces, the poor phone-size readability and the anatomy. The original layout (headboards on the shared wall, camera facing the front cut) puts faces sideways or crown-to-camera, makes 'forehead to the wall' impossible, and leaves each face tiny in the wide. The new layout is an overhead roofless dollhouse. Beds run flush along the shared wall with their heads at the back, so the beds run vertically in the 9:16 frame. The camera is locked to the wall's center plane, tilted 18° from vertical, on a long lens (three.js fov 30°) for a tilt-shift miniature feel. Presets: PLAN WIDE is 3.2 m across at 10.6 m; MEDIUM is 1.4-1.6 m across at 4.6-5.3 m; TWO-SHOT ECHO is 0.8 m across at 2.64 m, with adult faces at 16% of frame height. The camera only rises, lowers or slides along the wall line. The two CAVITY MACRO inserts are the wall's own eye. Faces lying in bed point up at the lens, and the final shot has both siblings looking straight into it, which strengthens the POV framing. Ripple shader: a shared onBeforeCompile chunk adds emission wherever |distance(worldPos, knockPoint) - r(t)| < 0.04 m, with 6 ring slots so the eleven-knock bursts fit. A small volumetric shimmer runs along the cavity strip.
